quick_skim.title: A Candidate Counterexample to a Conjecture on ISS for Time-Delay Systems
quick_skim.abstract: We present a candidate counterexample to a conjecture stating that the existence of a Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional with a pointwise dissipation rate is sufficient for the input-to-state stability of time-delay systems. The counterexample has been derived through interactions with large language models.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: A candidate counterexample challenges the conjecture that a Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional with pointwise dissipation suffices for ISS of time-delay systems, derived via LLM interaction.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对一个关于时滞系统输入-状态稳定性的猜想构造了候选反例。作者指出，仅存在具有逐点耗散率的李雅普诺夫-克拉索夫斯基泛函并不足以保证ISS，并借助与大语言模型的交互推导出该反例。结果对这一稳定性判据的充分性提出质疑，对时滞系统的稳定性分析具有理论警示意义。
